items.Title: Accept Instant Payment Initiation Requests
items.Description: The platform shall expose POST /v1/payments to receive SCT Inst initiation requests from participating FIs and route valid requests into the processing pipeline.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 2.1 Purpose and Scope; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given an authenticated FI client and a syntactically valid payment payload, When the client calls POST /v1/payments, Then the gateway accepts the request and starts processing.

items.Title: Enforce OAuth2 Authentication
items.Description: The gateway shall require valid OAuth2 client credentials for payment initiation and reject missing or invalid credentials with HTTP 401.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.1 Primary Flows; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 5.3 Validation Rules
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a payment request without valid OAuth2 credentials, When it reaches the gateway, Then the response is HTTP 401 and processing is not continued.

items.Title: Validate Request Schema Before Business Processing
items.Description: The gateway shall validate request syntax and required fields before invoking downstream validation and fraud components.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.1 Primary Flows; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 5.3 Validation Rules
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a malformed request payload, When the gateway performs schema validation, Then the request is rejected with a machine-readable error and is not forwarded downstream.

items.Title: Validate Debtor and Creditor IBANs
items.Description: The validation engine shall verify debtorIban and creditorIban compliance with ISO 13616 and reject invalid values.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.2 Components; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 5.3 Validation Rules
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a request with an invalid debtorIban or creditorIban, When validation executes, Then the payment is rejected with a validation error code and reason.

items.Title: Reject Invalid BIC With Standard Error Code
items.Description: The validation engine shall enforce creditorBic format validation and return code IP-VAL-002 for invalid BIC values.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 5.3 Validation Rules; 8.1 Error Categories
items.Traceability: BIC Format Rule, Error Code IP-VAL-002
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a request containing an invalid creditorBic, When the validation engine checks BIC format, Then the system rejects the request using IP-VAL-002 and a descriptive message.

items.Title: Enforce Maximum Amount Rule
items.Description: The validation engine shall reject payment amounts above 100000 EUR and allow amounts at or below the limit.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 5.3 Validation Rules; 9.2 Constraints
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a request amount of 100000 EUR or less, When amount validation runs, Then the amount passes; Given an amount above 100000 EUR, When validation runs, Then the request is rejected.

items.Title: Prevent Duplicate EndToEndId Within 48 Hours
items.Description: The validation engine shall enforce EndToEndId uniqueness in a rolling 48-hour window and reject duplicates.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.2 Components; 4.1 Primary Flows; 5.3 Validation Rules
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a payment with an EndToEndId seen within the past 48 hours, When duplicate checks run, Then the request is rejected as duplicate with a machine-readable code.

items.Title: Route Validated Payments Through Fraud Decisioning
items.Description: The platform shall submit successfully validated transactions to the fraud engine for risk evaluation before clearing submission.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.1 High-Level Architecture; 4.1 Primary Flows
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a payment that passed schema and business validation, When processing continues, Then the transaction is evaluated by the fraud engine before any clearing handoff.

items.Title: Reject High-Risk Payments With RJCT
items.Description: The fraud engine shall return a rejected outcome for high-risk transactions and block clearing submission for those transactions.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.1 High-Level Architecture; 4.1 Primary Flows; 8.1 Error Categories
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a transaction classified as high risk, When fraud decisioning completes, Then the status is RJCT and the transaction is not submitted to clearing.

items.Title: Submit Accepted Payments To Clearing
items.Description: The clearing adapter shall submit transactions accepted by fraud controls to settlement processing using the agreed contract.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.2 Components; 4.1 Primary Flows; 3.3 Integration Points
items.Components: Fraud Engine, Clearing Adapter, Settlement Simulator
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a low-risk accepted payment, When fraud decisioning returns accepted, Then the clearing adapter transmits the transaction for settlement.

items.Title: Return Synchronous Technical Acceptance Status
items.Description: The gateway shall return synchronous status details including messageId, status, statusReason, and correlationId for syntactically valid requests.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.1 Primary Flows; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 7.1 Performance
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a syntactically valid request, When the gateway acknowledges processing, Then the response includes messageId, status, statusReason, and correlationId.

items.Title: Publish Final Status Callback After Settlement
items.Description: The notification service shall publish final transaction status to the FI callback endpoint after settlement response is received.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.2 Components; 4.1 Primary Flows; 4.2 Exception Flows
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a settlement outcome exists for a transaction, When the notification service processes it, Then a final status callback is sent to the configured FI endpoint.

items.Title: Retry Callback Delivery On Endpoint Failure
items.Description: The notification service shall retry delivery when the FI callback endpoint is unavailable and shall log each failed attempt.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.1 Settlement and Final Notification; 8.2 Retry Logic; 8.1 Error Categories
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a callback attempt fails due to endpoint unavailability, When delivery logic executes, Then the service retries according to policy and records each attempt outcome.

items.Title: Allow Cancellation Only In Pending Settlement State
items.Description: The platform shall accept camt.056 cancellation requests only when the original payment is still pending settlement.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.1 Pending Cancellation; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 5.2 Message Formats
items.Components: Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Clearing Adapter
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a cancellation request for a pending payment, When state validation runs, Then cancellation is accepted; Given the payment is not pending, When cancellation is requested, Then it is rejected with an explicit reason.

items.Title: Provide Operations Query By EndToEndId
items.Description: The operations query endpoint shall return current status and lifecycle history for a known EndToEndId, and return not found for unknown identifiers.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.2 Components; 4.1 Operations Status Inquiry
items.Components: Operations Query Endpoint, Audit Trail Store
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a known EndToEndId, When an operations user submits a query, Then the endpoint returns status and event history; Given an unknown EndToEndId, When queried, Then a not found response is returned.

items.Title: Secure FI Integration Over TLS 1.2+
items.Description: The FI-to-gateway integration shall require TLS 1.2 or higher for all payment initiation traffic.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.3 Integration Points; 5.1 APIs and Endpoints; 7.3 Security
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a client attempts to connect using an unsupported TLS version, When the connection is negotiated, Then the request is refused before API processing.

items.Title: Use Contracted Interface For Clearing Handoff
items.Description: The clearing adapter shall transform accepted payment data into the settlement interface contract before submission.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.2 Components; 3.3 Integration Points; 6.3 Data Transformations
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given an accepted transaction, When the clearing adapter performs handoff, Then the payload conforms to the agreed settlement contract format.

items.Title: Deliver Final Status To FI Callback Endpoints
items.Description: The notification service shall integrate with FI callback endpoints to deliver asynchronous final payment statuses.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 3.3 Integration Points; 4.1 Settlement and Final Notification
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a final settlement status is available, When notification processing runs, Then the FI callback endpoint receives the corresponding status payload.

items.Title: Support ISO 20022 Message Family Semantics
items.Description: The platform shall process and map payment lifecycle interactions according to ISO 20022 message families pacs.008, pacs.002, and camt.056.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 2.3 Domain Context; 5.2 Message Formats
items.Components: Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Clearing Adapter, Notification Service
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given inbound and outbound payment lifecycle events, When messages are handled, Then statuses and processing semantics align with the supported ISO 20022 message families.

items.Title: Maintain Immutable Lifecycle Audit Evidence
items.Description: The platform shall store immutable audit records for each lifecycle event, including timestamp, actor, decision, and reason.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 2.1 Purpose and Scope; 7.4 Compliance
items.Components: Audit Trail Store, Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Fraud Engine, Clearing Adapter, Notification Service
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given any payment lifecycle transition, When the transition occurs, Then an immutable audit event is recorded with timestamp, actor, decision, and reason.

items.Title: Meet End-To-End Latency Target
items.Description: The service shall achieve p95 end-to-end payment processing latency below 10 seconds under defined operating conditions.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 1. Executive Summary; 7.1 Performance
items.Components: Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Fraud Engine, Clearing Adapter, Notification Service
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given representative production-like load, When latency is measured across complete payment flows, Then the p95 processing time is under 10 seconds.

items.Title: Respond Within Two Seconds For Valid Requests
items.Description: The gateway shall return synchronous technical status responses within 2 seconds for syntactically valid payment initiation requests.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.3 Timing and SLAs; 7.1 Performance
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given syntactically valid initiation requests, When response latency is measured at the API boundary, Then the synchronous status response time is at most 2 seconds.

items.Title: Issue Final Callback Within Five Seconds
items.Description: The notification service shall issue final status callbacks within 5 seconds after settlement response receipt.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 4.3 Timing and SLAs; 7.1 Performance
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a settlement response timestamp, When callback dispatch occurs, Then the callback is issued within 5 seconds.

items.Title: Sustain Minimum Throughput Capacity
items.Description: The platform shall sustain at least 250 transactions per second while preserving core correctness and stability characteristics.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 1. Executive Summary; 7.1 Performance
items.Components: Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Fraud Engine, Clearing Adapter
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given load testing with realistic payment patterns, When the system operates at 250 TPS, Then processing remains stable and requirements for correctness are maintained.

items.Title: Achieve Monthly Availability Objective
items.Description: The service shall achieve at least 99.95% monthly availability for payment initiation and status lifecycle operations.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 7.2 Availability; 4.3 Timing and SLAs
items.Components: Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Fraud Engine, Clearing Adapter, Notification Service, Operations Query Endpoint
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a calendar month of monitored operations, When service uptime is calculated using agreed measurement rules, Then monthly availability is at least 99.95%.

items.Title: Persist Canonical Payment Instruction Fields
items.Description: The platform shall persist canonical payment instruction data including messageId, endToEndId, debtorIban, creditorIban, creditorBic, amount, currency, and requestedExecutionDateTime.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 6.1 Key Entities
items.Components: Payments Gateway, Validation Engine, Audit Trail Store
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a syntactically valid payment request, When canonicalization completes, Then all required PaymentInstruction fields are stored and retrievable.

items.Title: Store Callback Delivery Attempts For Traceability
items.Description: The system shall record callback delivery metadata including destinationUrl, deliveryAttempt, result, and lastAttemptAt for each notification lifecycle.
items.Source: SAMPLE_IP_context_complete.md, 6.1 Key Entities; 8.2 Retry Logic
items.Acceptance_Criteria: Given a callback attempt is executed, When the attempt completes, Then delivery metadata is persisted with attempt outcome and timestamp.
